title: Meetup Events Scraper
description: Scrape public Meetup.com events three ways: keyword + location search, a group's full event list, or a single event URL/ID. Modes auto-detect from the inputs you fill.

searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Keyword searches run on Meetup events, one entry per term (e.g. 'technology', 'yoga', 'startup networking'). Pair with a location (city, zip, or lat+lon) — Meetup search is location-scoped. Leave empty if you only want group or event URLs. NOT a group or event URL.

city.title: City
city.description: City to scope the keyword search to (e.g. 'New York'). Combine with state/country for accuracy. Ignored for group-URL and event-URL modes. NOT a venue name.

state.title: State / region
state.description: State or region code for the search location (e.g. 'NY'). Optional refinement on top of city. Ignored outside search mode. NOT a country.

country.title: Country code
country.description: Two-letter country code for the search location (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

zip.title: ZIP / postal code
zip.description: Postal code to scope the search (e.g. '10001'). Alternative to city. Ignored outside search mode.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Latitude for a precise geo-scoped search (e.g. 40.7128). Use with lon and radius for map-bounded searches. Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

lon.title: Longitude
lon.description: Longitude for a precise geo-scoped search (e.g. -74.006). Use with lat and radius. Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

radius.title: Radius (miles)
radius.description: Search radius in miles around the lat/lon or city (e.g. 50). Defaults to Meetup's default when omitted. Ignored outside search mode.

eventType.title: Event type filter
eventType.description: Restrict search results to a single format. PHYSICAL = in-person, ONLINE = virtual, HYBRID = both. Leave as 'Any' for all formats. Ignored outside search mode.

startDate.title: Start date (from)
startDate.description: Only return search events starting on or after this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'). Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

endDate.title: Start date (to)
endDate.description: Only return search events starting on or before this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'). Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

minRsvpCount.title: Minimum RSVPs
minRsvpCount.description: Only return search events with at least this many RSVPs (e.g. 10) — filters out tiny events. Optional. Ignored outside search mode.

sortField.title: Sort search by
sortField.description: Order search results by RELEVANCE (Meetup's match score) or DATETIME (chronological). Defaults to RELEVANCE. Ignored outside search mode.

groupUrls.title: Group URLs
groupUrls.description: Meetup group URLs or urlnames to pull every event from (e.g. 'https://www.meetup.com/nyc-tech/' or just 'nyc-tech'). Returns the group's upcoming or past events (see groupEventStatus). NOT an event URL.

groupEventStatus.title: Group events: upcoming or past
groupEventStatus.description: For group-URL mode, choose which events to return: upcoming (future, ascending) or past (history, most-recent first). Defaults to upcoming. Only applies to groupUrls.

eventUrls.title: Event URLs or IDs
eventUrls.description: Specific Meetup event URLs or numeric event IDs to fetch directly (e.g. 'https://www.meetup.com/nyc-tech/events/315015546/' or '315015546'). Best for enriching a known list of events. NOT a group URL.

maxItems.title: Max events
maxItems.description: Hard cap on total unique events returned across all modes (e.g. 200). Stops pagination and charging once reached. Defaults to 200. Raise for deep crawls.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.
